description_en: Lists the dialogue data for a search generation task
description_zh: 查询搜索生成任务对话详情中数据列表
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi list-search-task-dialogue-datas --workspace-id xxxx --query xx --task-id xxx --original-session-id xx --session-id xx --multimodal-search-type text --search-model ClusterGenerate --search-model-data-value xxx --include-content true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSearchTaskDialogueDatas

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the task.

You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically generates a task ID. If you specify the same task ID for multiple tasks, the tasks are considered part of the same dialogue group
parameters.help_zh:
任务唯一标识
TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the historical dialogue. This is the source of all original materials
parameters.help_zh: 历史对话唯一标识：全量原始素材来源
parameters.name: original_session_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the historical dialogue. This is the source of reference materials
parameters.help_zh: 历史对话唯一标识：参考素材来源
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The type of data to search
parameters.name: multimodal_search_type

parameters.help_en: The data under the search agent classification
parameters.name: search_model_data_value

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether to include the main content
parameters.name: include_content

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 10
parameters.name: page_size
